rationale: Cycle 2 found a new 10.131 best, well above the GP maximum of 9.143. With seven batches left and high pool uncertainty, invest in uncertainty reduction and new scaffolds while retaining a small high-mean tranche.
expected_outcome: The batch will add at least 8 new scaffolds and contain at least one affinity of 8.8 or higher; improving 10.131 is not expected.
